📖 How to use

  1. Enter your total monthly expenses.
  2. Add your current emergency savings and monthly contribution.
  3. Read your 3/6/9-month targets and months until each is funded.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How big should my emergency fund be?

3-6 months of essential expenses is the standard guidance; 9-12 months suits freelancers or single-income households.

Where should I keep it?

Somewhere safe and liquid but slightly out of reach: a high-yield savings account, not invested in stocks.

What counts as monthly expenses?

Housing, food, transport, insurance, utilities and minimum debt payments — the bills that continue if income stops.
